messages.content: 約翰有5000美元想要投資。他正在考慮兩個選項。第一個選項是一個每年以4%的年利率按季度複利計算的儲蓄帳戶，為期5年。第二個選項是一個每年以3.5%的年利率提供單利的債券，為期5年。在5年後，約翰會有多少錢？

message.content:
**Option 1 – Quarterly‑compounded savings account**

\[
A_{\text{compound}} = P \left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}
\]

- \(P = \$5\,000\)
- Annual rate \(r = 0.04\)
- Compounding periods per year \(n = 4\)
- Time \(t = 5\) years  

\[
A_{\text{compound}} = 5\,000 \times \left(1+\frac{0.04}{4}\right)^{4\times5}
                     = 5\,000 \times (1.01)^{20}
                     \approx 5\,000 \times 1.22019
                     \approx \$6\,100.95
\]

So after 5 years he would have **about \$6,101**.

---

**Option 2 – Simple‑interest bond**

\[
A_{\text{simple}} = P \bigl(1+r t\bigr)
\]

- \(P = \$5\,000\)
- Annual rate \(r = 0.035\)
- Time \(t = 5\) years  

\[
A_{\text{simple}} = 5\,000 \times \bigl(1+0.035\times5\bigr)
                   = 5\,000 \times (1+0.175)
                   = 5\,000 \times 1.175
                   = \$5\,875
\]

After 5 years he would have **\$5,875**.

---

**Summary**

| Option | Future Value (after 5 years) |
|--------|-----------------------------|
| Quarterly‑compounded savings account | ≈ \$6,101 |
| Simple‑interest bond | \$5,875 |

The quarterly‑compounded savings account yields more money at the end of five years.
